content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional payment processing landscape is dominated by platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle, which often impose restrictions on creators from certain countries. However, by leveraging Cloudflare infrastructure and NOWPayments, you can bypass these limitations and establish a sovereign digital commerce stack that gives you full control over your payment processing and data ownership. This infrastructure works by utilizing Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, all for a fee of 0.5%. By doing so, you can sell ebooks from Kenya to international buyers without any platform restrictions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need to acquire the necessary tools and infrastructure. This includes the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which comprises all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates, providing everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. You'll also need to set up a NOWPayments account, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and has a 0.5% fee. Additionally, you'll require a Cloudflare account, which offers a range of features and tools to help you host, deploy, and manage your digital commerce stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to follow these steps. First, create a new NOWPayments account and integrate it with your Cloudflare infrastructure. Next, configure your payment settings to accept a range of cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. Then, set up your delivery pipeline by linking your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account to your NOWPayments account. Finally, configure your order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring that all orders are securely stored and processed.
You can process transactions from international buyers using over 300 cryptocurrencies supported by NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. To do this, simply deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack using Cloudflare infrastructure, and configure your payment settings to accept payments from international buyers. When a buyer makes a purchase, NOWPayments will automatically verify the payment on-chain, and your delivery pipeline will kick in to process the order and deliver the ebook. By following these steps, you'll be able to process your first transaction and start selling ebooks from Kenya to international buyers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running, it's time to scale your digital commerce operations. To do this, you can use the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to create new blueprints and templates, and deploy them to your Cloudflare infrastructure. You can also use NOWPayments to accept a range of cryptocurrencies, including those with lower fees, such as Binance P2P, which supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. By scaling your infrastructure and accepting a range of payment options, you'll be able to increase your revenue and grow your digital commerce business.
